statements.attributed: observed storage of 1.81 wt% hydrogen at 100 bar and 50 °C after activation at 500 °C after synthesis in ZrTiVCrFeNi
statements.quote: For example, Kunce et al. investigated the properties of ZrTiVCrFeNi, where they observed storage of 1.81 wt% hydrogen at 100 bar and 50 °C after activation at 500 °C after synthesis.

statements.attributed: found lower hydrogen storage (0.59 wt%) in the single phase BCC-type structure as compared to the multiphase material (2.3 wt%), at a hydrogen pressure of 85 bar at 50 °C in TiZrNbMoV
statements.quote: They also studied TiZrNbMoV and found lower hydrogen storage (0.59 wt%) in the single phase BCC-type structure as compared to the multiphase material (2.3 wt%), at a hydrogen pressure of 85 bar at 50 °C.

statements.attributed: developed a profile refinement method for nuclear and magnetic structures
statements.quote: The structure of the sample as-synthesized was refined from the X-ray diffraction data using the Rietveld method implemented in the FullProf program.

statements.attributed: developed a program for magnetic structure determination by neutron powder diffraction
statements.quote: The structure of the sample as-synthesized was refined from the X-ray diffraction data using the Rietveld method implemented in the FullProf program.

statements.attributed: developed a Thompson-Cox-Hastings pseudo-Voigt peak function
statements.quote: The background was refined with a 4th order Chebychev polynomial and a Thompson-Cox-Hastings pseudo-Voigt peak function was used to describe the peak profile.

statements.attributed: reported that Ti20Zr20Hf20Nb20X20 (X = V or Cr) refractory high-entropy alloys crystallize in a simple BCC-type structure
statements.quote: As can be seen from Fig. 1a, the XRD pattern of the alloy as-deposited indicated that TiVZrNbHf crystallizes in a simple BCC-type structure (W-type,) in agreement with previous studies.

statements.attributed: observed a tetragonal distortion that can be indexed using a 1 × 1 × 2 super cell (doubling along the c-axis) in light rare-earth metals such as La, Ce, Pr, and Nd at H/M-ratios above 2.3
statements.quote: This is similar behaviour to that seen with the light rare-earth metals such as La, Ce, Pr, and Nd at H/M-ratios above 2.3 where a tetragonal distortion was noticed that can be indexed using a 1 × 1 × 2 super cell (doubling along the c-axis).

statements.attributed: observed a distorted BCC phase in Ti−Mn-V BCC solid solution alloys
statements.quote: However for intermediate hydrogen content, a distorted BCC phase has been observed in many transition metal-hydrogen systems (BCC → distorted BCC (BCT) → FCC).

statements.attributed: observed a distorted BCC phase in alloys of vanadium and titanium
statements.quote: However for intermediate hydrogen content, a distorted BCC phase has been observed in many transition metal-hydrogen systems (BCC → distorted BCC (BCT) → FCC).

statements.attributed: observed a distorted BCC phase in titanium hydrides

statements.attributed: observed an elongation of the c-axis by about 10% in the α-β transition in the V-H system
statements.quote: This type of lattice distortion, illustrated in Fig. 4. with an elongation of one of the cube axes has been observed in the α-β transition in the V-H system, where the c-axis is elongated by about 10%.

statements.attributed: observed a tetragonal distortion of the FCC lattice (with c/a < 1) for Ti, Zr and Hf for H concentrations above the critical values but with H/M < 2
statements.quote: In the case of Ti, Zr and Hf, a tetragonal distortion of the FCC lattice (with c/a < 1) is observed for H concentrations above the critical values but with H/M < 2.

statements.attributed: investigated the instability of the FCC ZrH2 lattice using electronic structure calculations
statements.quote: Wang et al. investigated the instability of the FCC ZrH2 lattice using electronic structure calculations.

statements.attributed: observed a tetragonal distortion at higher hydrogen contents (dHCP → FCC → distorted FCC (BTC))
statements.quote: At higher hydrogen contents, a tetragonal distortion is observed (dHCP → FCC → distorted FCC (BTC)).

statements.attributed: showed by neutron diffraction on NdD2.36 that the tetragonal distortion results from formation of a super cell that is doubled in the c-direction
statements.quote: This tetragonal distortion has been shown by neutron diffraction on NdD2.36 to result from formation of a super cell that is doubled in the c-direction.

statements.attributed: found that additional hydrogen atoms occupy the octahedral sites in the structure of CeH2.48
statements.quote: In the case of CeH2.48 the additional hydrogen atoms were found to occupy the octahedral sites in the structure.

statements.attributed: proposed that HEAs are formed when δ < 6.6%
statements.quote: Yang and Zhang have proposed that HEAs are formed when δ < 6.6% For TiVZrNbHf δ is 6.8% (atomic radius from), which is slightly above the maximum value defined by Yang and Zhang.

statements.attributed: observed a change from tetrahedral to octahedral occupancy at low hydrogen concentrations in vanadium
statements.quote: Even at low hydrogen concentrations, a change from tetrahedral to octahedral occupancy is observed.

statements.attributed: observed a change from hexagonal to cubic crystal structure at very high pressures (~77 kbar) in the Y-H system
statements.quote: This is in agreement with previous results on, for example, the Y-H system where a change from hexagonal to cubic crystal structure is observed at very high pressures (~77 kbar).
